environment: PyBullet 3.2.7 / native 3D rigid-body and articulated-joint simulation
note: Selected successful JevAny-27B-SFT run, replayed from native PyBullet frames. Original option probabilities are preserved. Playback is accelerated; it does not measure single-attempt success rate.

actions.seat: Lower into the socket. Lower the held peg to the mouth of the socket, ready for gravity-assisted seating.
actions.finish: Finish. Stop without any further movement.
actions.grasp: Close fingers in place. Send a finger-closing command only. Contact requires XY alignment and the gripper already being at object grasp height.
actions.red_socket: Align with red socket. Move above the red socket at safe transport height.
actions.lift: Lift with the gripper. Lift vertically to a safe transport height, maintaining the finger command.
actions.cyan_socket: Align with cyan socket. Move above the cyan socket at safe transport height.
actions.release: Open and retract. Open the fingers at the current position and retract upward.
actions.approach: Approach peg. Move directly above the peg at safe height, keeping the current finger opening.
actions.lower: Descend to grasp height. Move the gripper down vertically to the object's current grasp height at the current x-y position.
